Name: (CP) Vanillaish Elena (Genderbend Elliott)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits of your genderbend poet, Elena, vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Use in tandem with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].

[b][color=#ff7700]INSTRUCTION:[/color][/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Elena into your mod folder.
﻿- That's it!

[b][color=#ff7700]COMPATIBILITY:[/color][/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿- Other mod that change Elliott portraits: depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Elliott changes in those mod.

[b][color=#ff7700]PERMISSIONS:[/color][/b] As always, I don't block any of my mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want. 

[b][color=#ff7700]CREDITS:[/color][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] for inspiration.
